name: lighthouse-ops
description: Tencent Lighthouse Expert: quickly create Lighthouse servers with instance queries, firewall configuration, snapshot backups, monitoring alerts, command execution, and cloud deployment and hosting for applications.

displayDescription.en: Tencent Lighthouse Expert: helps you quickly create Lighthouse servers, supporting common cloud resource management features like instance queries, firewall configuration, and snapshot backups, ops actions such as monitoring alerts and command execution, plus cloud deployment and hosting for websites and other applications.
displayDescription.zh: 腾讯轻量云 Lighthouse 专家：帮你快速创建轻量应用服务器，支持实例查询、防火墙配置、快照备份等云资源常用管理功能，支持监控告警与命令执行等运维操作，并提供网站等各类应用云端部署与托管能力。
